sections.title: Overview
sections.text: Overview Sea slugs are a diverse informal grouping of marine gastropod mollusks. Nudibranchs are one group of sea slugs; other groups include sea hares and sacoglossans. This collection will grow as new Naturalist material and species guides are added.
